title: JMeter Web Insight Report — run data, version 1.x
description: One record of a run data file: JSON Lines, one record per line, UTF-8, gzip when the name ends in .gz. The first line is the run record; the others may come in any order. A producer validates each line against this schema. A reader of 1.x skips a record type or a field it does not know, so a minor version can add them; this schema is the 1.1 producer's, and names every field it writes. 1.1 added the optional threshold fields statistic, measuredValue, metricType and metricContains, and the run record's trendStatistics.

epochMillis.description: A time in epoch milliseconds: 11 to 15 digits. Seconds (10 digits) and micro- or nanoseconds (16 or more) are refused.

run.description: The first line, exactly one: who recorded the run, its test name, and what its tool does not record.

formatVersion.description: The run data version, <major>.<minor>. A reader refuses a major version it does not read, naming both.

name.description: The tool that recorded the samples, lower case: jmeter, k6. It names the report's tool tab.

version.description: The tool's version, as the tool reports it.

testName.description: The report title. The run's identity (runId) hashes it.

name.description: Who wrote the file: jmeter-web-insight-report for the plugin and its k6 adapter.

timeResolution.description: s when the tool's file had whole-second times; ms by default.

notMeasured.description: Sample fields the tool does not record. Only these read "not measured" on the page.

trendStatistics.description: Since 1.1, optional: the statistics the tool's summary lists for a trend (k6's options.summaryTrendStats), such as avg, med, p(95), p(99).

sample.description: One request or transaction. A transaction with no elapsed takes the sum of its direct children's (link transaction), and with no success fails when a child failed, as JMeter's Transaction Controller does.

id.description: Unique in the file; needed when another sample names it as parent.

parent.description: The id of the sample it ran inside.

link.description: How it nests under its parent: a transaction's child, or a request's sub-result.

kind.description: transaction: counted as a transaction row (not in the Errors tab's sample count, no response code).

name.description: The request or transaction name (JMeter's label).

elapsed.description: The tool's own duration in ms. Required for a request.

idle.description: JMeter's IdleTime, ms. Wins over wallTime.

wallTime.description: A transaction's whole duration in ms, think time included.

success.description: The tool's own verdict on the sample. Required for a request.

code.description: Response code, or the tool's error code.

user.description: Who ran it: JMeter's thread name, or VU <n> for k6.

iteration.description: The pass of that user (k6's iter).

topLevel.description: Whether a listener in the test plan received it on its own. Default: true when it has no parent.

errors.description: JMeter's ErrorCount; default 0, or 1 for a failed sample.

threads.description: Active threads when it ended (JMeter's allThreads).

timings.description: The tool's timing parts in ms, to the hundredth.

responseBody.description: A failed sample's response body, as the report carries it: failed samples only, cut at webinsight.error.body.maxsize.

users.description: The active users at a time: k6's vus. Fed to the engine's active threads.

check.description: One check of one pass, as the tool judged it. Shown on the tool's tab; never a verdict.

group.description: The group path, ::A::B; empty outside any group.

threshold.description: One threshold of the tool's summary, as the tool judged it. Never a verdict.

metric.description: The metric with its tag filter: http_req_duration{name:Login}.

statistic.description: Since 1.1, optional: the statistic the expression names, as written: p(95), rate, count, max, value.

measuredValue.description: Since 1.1, optional: the value the tool judged the threshold on (k6's summary values[statistic]). Left out when the tool did not say, never 0.

metricType.description: Since 1.1, optional: the metric's type in the tool's words: trend, rate, counter, gauge.

metricContains.description: Since 1.1, optional: what the metric holds: time, data or default.

counter.description: A counter of the tool's summary: k6's iterations, dropped_iterations, vus_max.
